Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a review of the local government whistleblower program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a review of the local governmentwhistleblower program; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall review the local government whistleblower program. Thecommittee, in its review, shall consider, but not be limited to, thefollowing factors: The effectiveness of local reporting policies andinvestigation procedures including the officers responsible forinvestigations; the role county prosecutors play in employeewhistleblower investigations; internal conflicts of interest within thelocal government agency that may prevent robust investigation ofreports of improper governmental action; employee awareness of thewhistleblower program; employee confidence in program performance; theeffectiveness of the retaliatory action complaint process; and thefeasibility of providing an independent party to receive the report ofimproper governmental action and/or conduct the investigation. Thecommittee shall make recommendations regarding improvements to betterfacilitate the reporting and investigation of improper governmental p. 1 SB 5119action in local governments. The committee shall provide a finalreport on this review by December 1, 2006.
